definitions.explanation: How often something happens or is done. Used in both everyday and academic/technical contexts to describe the rate at which events, actions, or phenomena occur.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頻度|ひんど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: The frequency of earthquakes is increasing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{外食|がいしょく}→外食：03024_gaishoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頻度|ひんど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{減|へ}らして→減らす：02414_herasu⟧⟦{節約|せつやく}している→節約する：25226_setsuyakusuru⟧。
examples.english: I'm saving money by reducing how often I eat out.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{単語|たんご}→単語：03413_tango⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日常|にちじょう}→日常：01595_nichijou⟧⟦{会話|かいわ}→会話：01271_kaiwa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧{頻度|ひんど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}えた→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: This word has a high frequency of use in daily conversation, so it's better to learn it early.

notes:
USAGE:
{頻度|ひんど} is used with ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧/⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧ (high/low) rather than ⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧/⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧. This is a common mistake for learners.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {頻度|ひんど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ (high frequency)
- {頻度|ひんど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧ (low frequency)
- {頻度|ひんど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧ (to increase frequency)
- {頻度|ひんど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{減|へ}らす→減らす：02414_herasu⟧ (to reduce frequency)
- ⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧{頻度|ひんど} (frequency of use)
- ⟦{出現|しゅつげん}→出現：11758_shutsugen⟧{頻度|ひんど} (frequency of occurrence)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {頻度|ひんど}: frequency (how often; measurable rate)
- ⟦{回数|かいすう}→回数：00139_kaisuu⟧: number of times (countable occurrences)
- ⟦{割合|わりあい}→割合：01760_wariai⟧: proportion, ratio (relative measure)
